gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Audio-Technica AT-LP70XBT only pairs over Bluetooth with its pre-amplifier selector set to LINE. To pair, the speaker or headphones must sit within 1 m (3.3 ft), and pairing mode ends after about 120 seconds.
standout_why: I could not read the two cited rivals. What Hi-Fi's Bluetooth turntables page returned only its title, and Louder's best record players page returned only its title. TechRadar's best turntables page also returned only its title, and vinylpickup.com failed with a certificate error. I did read turntableverse.com, which ranked #1 and #2 in the two runs but wasn't cited. It already covers most of this angle: the codecs for each pick (aptX Adaptive, aptX and SBC on the AT-LP70XBT and Sony PS-LX3BT, none listing AAC), the fall-back to SBC, Sonos pairing and its Line-In Adapter, the AT-LP70XBT replacement stylus (AT-VMN95C, any VM95-series stylus) and What Hi-Fi's 8-device pairing count for the PS-LX310BT. It doesn't mention the LINE-switch requirement or the 1 m / 120 s pairing limits. Those are new, but they're setup details and don't change the pick.
decides: This confirms the AT-LP70XBT pick and doesn't change it. Bluetooth pairing needs the internal preamp on LINE. So a buyer who wires it to an amp's own phono input (switch on PHONO) has to flip the switch back to LINE to pair headphones or a speaker. I couldn't confirm from a maker document whether the AT models or the Sony can stream to two speakers at once, so the page shouldn't promise it.

findings.label: Pre-amplifier selector position needed to pair over Bluetooth
findings.value: LINE (step 2 of the pairing procedure: 'Set the pre-amplifier selector switch to the LINE side')
findings.source_title: AT-LP70XBT online user manual: Pairing a Bluetooth device (Audio-Technica)
findings.note: Maker's online manual. The step tells you to set the switch to LINE. It does not say outright that Bluetooth is off when the switch is on PHONO.

findings.label: Distance needed for pairing
findings.value: within 1 m (3.3 ft) of the turntable
findings.source_title: AT-LP70XBT online user manual: Pairing a Bluetooth device (Audio-Technica)
findings.note: Applies to the pairing step only. This page gives no figure for range during playback.

findings.label: Pairing-mode timeout
findings.source_title: AT-LP70XBT online user manual: Pairing a Bluetooth device (Audio-Technica)
findings.note: To start pairing, hold the Bluetooth connect button for about 2 s; the lamp flashes red and blue. The lamp turns solid blue once paired. The page says Audio-Technica 'cannot guarantee the operation of connected Bluetooth devices'.

findings.label: Power switch
findings.value: none; it draws standby current whenever the AC adapter is plugged in
findings.source_title: AT-LP70XBT online user manual: Pairing a Bluetooth device (Audio-Technica)
findings.note: The manual says to wait about 30 s after plugging in before playing, or the sound may be garbled.
